value.definition: the rule a turn breaks put back to the agent before that turn ends

invariants.statement: The words judged are the last the agent wrote rather than the whole turn.
The rules judged by are the ones the model tests name, and a rule may have more than one test.
A person stating no such rule leaves the turn alone.
What the person last asked for is judged beside the words the agent wrote back.
A tail holding nothing the person asked for is judged as an empty asking.
A seat answering to no person is left alone.
A turn the agent closed without words is left alone.
A stop this refused already is left alone.
Each rule is put to the model on its own.
The first rule answered yes ends the call and the rest are not read.
A yes is the model's last line rather than the model's opening word.
The words put back are the rule's own and nothing else.
A model reached by no call leaves the turn unjudged rather than holding that turn open.
Nothing here judges a tool call.
A turn held open twice running says so to the person.
A turn ending with a subagent or a background command still to report is left alone.
A subagent still to report is read from the seat's transcript rather than from a page.
Each run records the gate it stopped at, so a turn unjudged is told from one judged.
A seat with a background command open when its turn ends has that turn judged by nothing.
Thirteen runs in twenty reached no model while a bulk measurement ran on the same gateway.
A judge that answered is read even where another judge's call reached no model.
One seat ended all 28 of its turns with a subagent still to report, so none were judged.
A rule answered yes on is kept beside the test that asked it, turn and answer both.
Ten runs in ten reached a model with the gateway otherwise quiet.
